insights: Shorts significantly outperform long-form videos, with shorts averaging over 1,000 views while long-form videos mostly struggle below 55 views (excluding one outlier).
The 'Future scenario' and 'Shocking fact first' styles perform consistently well for shorts, driving higher average view percentages and high scores (e.g. 1.0+).
Myth vs fact and curiosity-driven formats (like 'NASA Stacks the Massive Artemis III Moon Rocket') achieve exceptional engagement, such as 114.27% average view percentage.
Comments are consistently near zero across almost all videos, indicating that a stronger end-screen call-to-action or explicit engagement question is urgently needed.
Early drop-offs frequently occur between 4 to 8 seconds into shorts, pointing to hooks that need to be punchier to immediately retain viewers.
Long-form content suffers from low initial reach and poor click-through interest (topic/title/thumbnail appeal), despite decent retention from the few who do click.
